description_en: Invokes RemoveClientIdFromOIDCProvider to remove a specified client ID from an OIDC IdP
description_zh: 调用RemoveClientIdFromOIDCProvider移除OIDC身份提供商中的指定客户端ID
name: RemoveClientIdFromOIDCProvider

parameters.help_en: The name of an existing OIDC IdP that has the target `ClientId` attached. If you have not created or attached one, call `CreateOIDCProvider` (with `ClientIds` specified) or `AddClientIdToOIDCProvider` first
parameters.help_zh: 已存在且已绑定目标 `ClientId` 的 OIDC 身份提供商名称。如果尚未创建或绑定，可先调用 `CreateOIDCProvider`（设置 `ClientIds`）或 `AddClientIdToOIDCProvider`
parameters.name: oidc_provider_name

parameters.help_en:
The client ID to remove.

Format: letters, digits, and the special characters `.-_:/` are allowed. The value cannot start with the special characters `.-_:/`.

Length: up to 128 characters
parameters.help_zh:
指定的客户端ID。

格式：允许英文字母、数字、特殊字符`.-_:/`，不能以特殊字符`.-_:/`开头。

长度：最大128个字符
parameters.name: client_id

OIDCProvider.description_en: The information about the OIDC IdP

Arn.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the OIDC IdP

ClientIds.description_en: The client IDs. Multiple client IDs are separated by commas (,)
ClientIds.description_zh: 客户端ID。多个之间用半角逗号（,）分隔

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the OIDC IdP was created. The time is displayed in UTC

Description.description_en: The description of the OIDC IdP
Description.example: This is a new OIDC Provider.

Fingerprints.description_en: The fingerprints of the HTTPS CA certificate. Multiple fingerprints are separated by commas (,)
Fingerprints.description_zh: HTTPS CA证书的验证指纹。多个之间用半角逗号（,）分隔

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the OIDC IdP was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the OIDC IdP was last modified. The value is a UNIX timestamp

IssuanceLimitTime.description_en:
The earliest time when an external IdP is allowed to issue an ID token. If the iat field in the ID token indicates a time earlier than the current time by more than this value, the request is rejected.
Unit: hours. Valid values: 1 to 168
IssuanceLimitTime.description_zh:
允许外部IdP颁发ID Token的最早签发时间。ID Token中的iat字段如果距离当前时间大于这个值则请求会被拒绝。
单位：小时。取值范围：1~168

OIDCProviderName.description_en: The name of the OIDC IdP

UpdateDate.description_en: The time when the OIDC IdP was last modified. The time is displayed in UTC
